title: A perfect downtown place to stay!!!
description:
Our condo is located right on the river in downtown Nashville. It is 0.9 miles from Broadway, where all the honkey tonk bars are.  We are very close to the AAA Baseball Stadium that hosts the Nashville Sounds.  There is free, unreserved covered parking and the condo is on the first floor.  It is very easy to access. Let us know if you have any questions!  We would love to host you!

The space
Whether you're looking for Nashville night life or a peaceful retreat, our condo offers both. located right on the river in downtown.
